request: Advanced-route deliverable: nursing-home quality-collapse early warning. Pull CMS Nursing Home Health Deficiencies (r5ix-sfxw, 12mo since 2025-07-24). Enrich with days_since_survey, days_to_correction. Compute per-provider F1/F2/F3 signals in trend_analysis rollup. Publish two DSes on Cloud under Prep Agent. F4 hospital-spillover and F5 PBJ staffing are declared as scope decisions (F4 pulled from existing HealthData Hospital Capacity DS at dashboard-time; F5 is RED gap).

sources.name: CMS Nursing Home Health Deficiencies 12mo
sources.description: CMS Nursing Home Health Inspection Deficiencies (Provider Data API datastore r5ix-sfxw). One row = one health-inspection citation. Filtered to survey_date > 2025-07-24 (~12mo). Public, keyless. limit/offset pagination.

args.name: Nursing Home Collapse Trend
args.features_description: Per-citation nursing-home deficiency records with days_since_survey, days_to_correction, scope-severity, and category encoding. Use in Tableau to drive per-provider collapse risk score via aggregation on ccn.
args.stats_description: Per-(state, provider, category) deficiency rollups: monthly counts, 90-day rolling counts, YoY deltas, z-score anomalies. Use to spot providers with surging widespread-severity citations or clustered survey activity.

outputs.name: Nursing Home Deficiency Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level CMS nursing-home health-inspection deficiencies over the last 12 months (survey_date > 2025-07-24). Includes ccn, provider_name, city/state, survey_date, correction_date, deficiency_tag_number + deficiency_description, scope_severity_code, deficiency_category, inspection_cycle, standard/complaint/infection-control flags, days_since_survey, days_to_correction, plus calendar features. Source: data.cms.gov/provider-data r5ix-sfxw. Refresh: monthly.

Advanced-route notes: this DS is the feature-level input to a composite provider-level collapse-risk score computed at dashboard time. Join at Tableau layer to: (a) 'CMS Nursing Home Providers' on cms_certification_number_ccn for full provider metadata; (b) 'HealthData Hospital Capacity' on state for F4 spillover signal. RED indicator: CMS PBJ staffing data is not on this site — F5 staffing signal is substituted with F1 F-tag clustering. Facilities under-staffed but with an otherwise clean deficiency history will not be flagged; the F1 proxy lags underlying staffing by ~1 survey cycle.

outputs.name: Nursing Home Deficiency Stats
outputs.description: Long-form per-(state, provider, deficiency category) statistics. Includes 90-day rolling counts, monthly counts, YoY deltas, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to identify providers with sudden clustering of widespread-severity citations.

server_publish.schedule_name_hint: Nursing Home Collapse Risk Monthly Refresh
